description: Get one component manifest. Answer with section to stay inside the token budget: summary (default), props, files, or raw for the whole manifest. Prefer search_components/list_components to find the id first.

framework.description: Filter props/files to one framework where the manifest is per-framework.

id.description: Component ID, e.g. button, dialog, pricing-block.

section.description: Part of the manifest to return (default summary).

name: get_component
